FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns rushing to and fro. But amidst the chaos, a peculiar sight catches the eye: the king, a stout and jovial man with a wild shock of hair, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING (he) gestures grandly, his voice booming across the land.

KING (he) "My dear subjects, I have a vision! A vision of a new era, a new aesthetic, a new way of life!"

ADVISOR 1 (she) "Your Majesty, what is this vision of yours?"

KING (he) "I shall create a kingdom unlike any other! A kingdom of... of... (he consults a parchment)...of VAPORWAVE!"

The advisors exchange skeptical glances, but the king presses on.

KING (he) "We shall adorn our castles with neon lights, our armor with holographic decals, and our banners with glitchy, distorted patterns!"

ADVISOR 2 (he) "But, Your Majesty, what of tradition? What of honor and chivalry?"

KING (he) "Pish posh! Those are quaint notions, relics of a bygone era! We shall forge a new path, a path of... of... (he consults the parchment again)...of FUTURISTIC FUNK!"

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE GREAT HALL - DAY

The king's advisors gather around a large, ornate table, where a team of artisans and designers are busy at work. They are surrounded by half-finished projects: a suit of armor with a built-in cassette player, a throne with a glowing, pixelated seat, and a banner with a distorted, VHS-style image of the kingdom's crest.

ADVISOR 3 (she) "Your Majesty, I must ask: have you considered the implications of this... this... (she gestures to the projects)...of this aesthetic?"

KING (he) "Implications? Ha! I am a visionary, a trailblazer! I shall not be bound by the constraints of tradition!"

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GARDENS - DAY

The king, resplendent in a neon-lit, mirrored helmet, strolls through the gardens, surrounded by his advisors and a retinue of courtiers. They are all dressed in the latest in vaporwave fashion: neon-colored jumpsuits, holographic sunglasses, and hair styled in elaborate, futuristic 'dos.

KING (he) "Behold, my friends! The future is now! The future is... (he consults the parchment once more)...is... (he grins)...is VAPORWAVE!"

ADVISOR 1 (she) "Your Majesty, I must admit... I am intrigued."

KING (he) "Intrigued? Ha! You shall be amazed, my dear subject! You shall be... (he pauses, a mischievous glint in his eye)...you shall be transported to a realm beyond the boundaries of time and space!"

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The camera pans up the castle walls, where a series of cryptic messages are scrawled in neon letters: "VAPORWAVE FOREVER!", "GLITCHES IN THE REALM", and "THE FUTURE IS NOW".

KING (he) (voiceover) "And so, my dear subjects, the kingdom of vaporwave is born. A kingdom of wonder, a kingdom of awe, a kingdom of... (he grins)...of pure, unadulterated FUNK!"

FADE TO BLACK.
